stories.title: Perplexity 用 GPT-6 Astra 写文案、改代码并监控生产系统，人工检查频率大幅下降
stories.sourceTitle: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
stories.summary: Perplexity 将 Astra 用于撰写对外沟通内容、修改软件以及监控生产系统，检查频率远低于使用早期模型时。这说明前沿模型正被交付端到端的真实业务闭环，而非仅做辅助建议。
stories.analysis: 信任度跃升的同时，可审计性和出错后的责任归属会成为新的瓶颈。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.

stories.title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 呼吁给 AI 发展踩刹车，并向 METR 等第三方开放模型评估
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic CEO says it’s time to pump the brakes on AI
stories.summary: Amodei 在一篇长文中主张放慢 AI 开发节奏，提出三步走方案，并让 METR 等第三方评估机构访问其模型，以核实公司对安全实践和承诺的遵守情况。头部实验室开始主动引入外部监督。
stories.analysis: 在竞速格局下主动减速，既是安全表态，也是为未来监管规则提前占位。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei says the time has come to slow down AI development and will give third-party evaluators like METR access to its models to help ensure its "adherence to safety practices and commitments." In a winding essay, Amodei proposed a three-st

stories.title: 前 EPA 官员警告：特朗普为加速 AI 数据中心建设放松环保监管，推高公众健康风险
stories.sourceTitle: Trump is giving data centers a pass to pollute
stories.summary: 多位前美国环保署官员在一份新报告和简报中称，特朗普政府以加快 AI 数据中心建设为由削弱环境法规，将增加美国人的健康风险，并呼吁重新评估。AI 算力扩张的环境成本正被摆上台面。
stories.analysis: 算力竞赛的隐性账单位于地方社区，这会成为数据中心选址的政治阻力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: President Donald Trump is weakening environmental regulations in the name of speeding up the construction of AI data centers, raising health risks for Americans, a cadre of former EPA officials said this week in a briefing and new report. They are urging - per

stories.title: Sam Altman 称 OpenAI 2026 年上市“不明智”，但已秘密提交 IPO 申请
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI’s Sam Altman says it would be ‘ill-advised’ to go public in 2026
stories.summary: Altman 表示 OpenAI 虽已保密提交 IPO 文件，但今年不会上市，此时公开上市并非明智选择。巨额资本需求与公开市场审视之间的取舍仍在持续。
stories.analysis: 推迟上市保住了战略自由度，代价是融资更依赖私募和大客户绑定。
stories.sourceExcerpt: While OpenAI has filed confidentially for an IPO, the company will not be going public this year, according to CEO Sam Altman.

stories.title: Anthropic CEO 给出“放慢前沿”的具体方案，与 Altman 立场趋同
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic CEO outlines plan to slow AI development
stories.summary: TechCrunch 梳理了 Dario Amodei 的减速计划，并指出他与 OpenAI 的 Sam Altman 似乎都认为该“pace the frontier”，即放慢前沿模型推进节奏。问题已从要不要减速转向如何落地。
stories.analysis: 口号趋同但分歧犹存，真正的博弈在谁来定义节奏和标准。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anthropic's Dario Amodei and OpenAI's Sam Altman seem to agree that it's time to "pace the frontier." What would that actually look like?

stories.title: OpenAI 宣称解出一个千禧年大奖难题，把数学突破变成竞争叙事
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI just wants to win
stories.summary: The Verge 报道称，OpenAI 本周拿下其数学版图中最大的战果之一——对一个传奇的千禧年大奖难题给出解法。这本该是学术界的重大时刻，却被放进公司竞争的语境中。
stories.analysis: 把科研成果当作胜负记分牌，反映的是 OpenAI 当下的叙事焦虑。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI has spent the last few years planting flags across the increasingly difficult terrain in mathematics. This week, it claimed one of its biggest prizes yet: a solution to a legendary Millennium Prize problem. In normal circumstances, this would have been

stories.title: 新墨西哥州律师因在上诉中使用 AI 虚构证人和警方证词被罚 5000 美元
stories.sourceTitle: Lawyer fined $5K over AI-hallucinated witnesses in a murder case
stories.summary: 据路透社报道，新墨西哥州最高法院对律师 Stephen Aarons 处以 5000 美元罚款，因其在为客户的谋杀定罪上诉时援引了 AI 捏造的证人和虚假警方证词。法院首次对 AI 幻觉进入司法文书作出实质追责。
stories.analysis: 罚款金额不大，但明确了律师对 AI 生成内容负有不可转移的核查义务。
stories.sourceExcerpt: New Mexico's Supreme Court is punishing a lawyer for including AI-fabricated witnesses and fake police testimony in an appeal for his client's murder conviction, according to a report from Reuters. In a filing on Wednesday, the court fined Stephen Aarons $5,00

stories.title: Meta 称将修改 AI 聊天机器人提问建议，此前被曝追问用户未成年女儿的隐私
stories.sourceTitle: Meta says it’s changing AI suggestions after posing invasive personal questions
stories.summary: 一段病毒式传播的视频显示 Meta 的 AI 聊天机器人打探一名女性年幼女儿的个人信息，Meta 随后向 The Verge 表示正在调整提示词。AI 主动追问隐私的边界再度引发质疑。
stories.analysis: 产品为了“更懂你”而越界，隐私设计必须前置而不是事后补救。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta says it's making changes to the prompts suggested by its AI chatbot after a viral video showed it digging for personal information about a woman's young daughters, as reported earlier by Futurism. In a statement to The Verge, Meta spokesperson Dina El-Kas

stories.title: Slack 推出 Slackforce Surfaces，可在聊天中用自然语言生成交互式图表和报表
stories.sourceTitle: Slack can now vibe-code interactive charts and reports inside chats
stories.summary: 新功能允许用户向 Slackbot 描述需求，由 AI 收集数据并直接生成交互式报告、投票、仪表盘、演示文稿和微型网站。做报表正在变成一句话的事。
stories.analysis: 把 BI 能力塞进聊天流，冲击的是一批轻量级数据可视化工具。
stories.sourceExcerpt: A new feature coming to Slack will allow you to build interactive reports, polls, dashboards, presentations, microsites, and other tools directly inside a chat. With Slackforce Surfaces, you can describe to Slackbot what you need, and it will use AI to gather

stories.title: 学校开始识破大科技公司的 AI 推广剧本
stories.sourceTitle: Schools are catching on to Big Tech’s playbook
stories.summary: The Verge 指出，科技公司以“不学就落后”的话术、免费资源和课程向学校推广新技术，这套剧本与上一轮教育科技推广如出一辙，正在被教育界看穿。
stories.analysis: 上一轮是 Chromebook，这一轮是 AI 课程，学校该谈条件而不是被动接受。
stories.sourceExcerpt: It's the hot new thing in tech, and it's where all the jobs are. Students who don't learn to use it fall behind. And to help them catch up in time, its creators are graciously providing the resources and curriculum for learning it, often pro bono. That's the n

stories.title: Meta 发布新助手 Muse，能代劳购物、邮件和行程规划但让评测者不适
stories.sourceTitle: Meta’s Muse AI works and creeps me out
stories.summary: Meta 推出其首个 AI 生产力助手 Muse，官方称该 agent 可帮忙在线购物、处理邮件和规划旅行等杂事。The Verge 记者实测后表示功能确实可用，但过程令人毛骨悚然。
stories.analysis: 能力越强的个人助理，越必须先回答“它到底看到了我多少数据”。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta has launched its new Muse assistant, marking the company's first real foray into AI-powered productivity tools. The company says its AI agent can "take the busywork off your plate" by helping you with online shopping, emails, trip-planning, and more. I de

stories.title: ChatGPT Work 上线 Data agent，用自然语言连接公司数据并生成仪表盘
stories.sourceTitle: Now everyone can put data to work
stories.summary: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT Work 中推出 Data agent，可接入企业数据、发现洞察并用自然语言构建交互式仪表盘。企业数据分析的门槛被进一步拉低。
stories.analysis: 分析工作从“会写 SQL”变成“会提问题”，受益者从分析师转向业务人员。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meet the Data agent in ChatGPT Work. Connect company data, uncover insights, and build interactive dashboards with AI using natural language.

stories.title: AI 对齐研究者 Paul Christiano 加入 OpenAI Foundation 董事会及安全委员会
stories.sourceTitle: Paul Christiano joins OpenAI Foundation Board
stories.summary: Paul Christiano 加入 OpenAI Foundation 董事会以及其安全与安全委员会，带来 AI 对齐、安全和标准方面的经验。OpenAI 在治理层面补充了安全技术背景。
stories.analysis: 把对齐领域最有话语权的人之一请进董事会，是姿态也是自我约束。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Paul Christiano joins the OpenAI Foundation Board and its Safety and Security Committee, bringing experience in AI alignment, safety, and standards.

stories.title: OpenAI 发文：更强且更便宜的 AI 正在扩大个人与企业可完成的工作
stories.sourceTitle: The Work Now Within Reach
stories.summary: 文章探讨能力更强、成本更低的 AI 如何扩大个人与企业能承担的工作范围，并让增长变得更经济。核心叙事是 AI 从工具变成可扩张的产能。
stories.analysis: 降价加提能是这轮竞争最实在的卖点，比榜单分数更能打动采购方。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Explore how more capable, affordable AI can expand the work people and businesses can accomplish—and make growth more economical.

stories.title: OpenAI 公开 Navier–Stokes 千禧年难题的 AI 解法，附 Lean 形式化证明
stories.sourceTitle: On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
stories.summary: OpenAI 分享了针对 Navier–Stokes 千禧年大奖难题的 AI 生成解法，包含文字说明和用 Lean 写成的形式化证明。若验证成立，这将是 AI 参与数学前沿的标志性事件。
stories.analysis: 形式化证明让验证成为可能，也让质疑有据可依，这比口头宣称更有分量。
stories.sourceExcerpt: We’re sharing an AI-generated solution to the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, including a writeup and a formal proof in Lean.

stories.title: OpenAI 扩大新闻业支持计划，从课堂覆盖到编辑部
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI expands initiatives to support journalism from classrooms to newsrooms
stories.summary: OpenAI 通过工具、培训和合作项目，为学生、教育者、记者和新闻机构提供支持。AI 公司正试图把与内容产业的关系从对抗转向合作。
stories.analysis: 在版权诉讼不断的背景下，这类投入更像是关系修复型投资。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI is expanding support for journalism with tools, training, and partnerships for students, educators, journalists, and news organizations.

stories.title: OpenAI 联合 AIRPPU 与 WAN-IFRA 在乌克兰启动独立新闻支持项目
stories.sourceTitle: Supporting independent journalism in Ukraine
stories.summary: OpenAI 与 AIRPPU、WAN-IFRA 合作推出 AI 项目，帮助乌克兰新闻机构提升创新能力、韧性并维护独立报道。AI 工具开始进入冲突地区的新闻基础设施。
stories.analysis: 在战事环境中支撑新闻韧性，是 AI 公司展示公共价值的高光场景。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI, AIRPPU and WAN-IFRA launch an AI program to help Ukrainian news organizations strengthen innovation, resilience, and independent journalism.

stories.title: OpenAI 的 Jakub Pachocki 撰文：强大 AI 如“异类心智”，需更强保障与国际协调
stories.sourceTitle: An Alien Mind
stories.summary: Jakub Pachocki 反思能力日益增强的 AI 以及保持其对齐的难题，呼吁加强安全措施并推动国际协调。这延续了 OpenAI 技术高层对超级智能风险的公开表态。
stories.analysis: 由核心技术负责人讲风险，比政策部门的表态更能影响内部优先级。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Jakub Pachocki reflects on increasingly capable AI and the challenge of keeping it aligned. He calls for stronger safeguards and international coordination.

stories.title: OpenAI 推出 Daybreak for Frontline Defenders，投入 10 亿美元保护关键服务
stories.sourceTitle: Daybreak for Frontline Defenders: $1B to protect essential services
stories.summary: 该计划扩大前沿网络 AI 能力、培训和技术支持的获取范围，面向守护关键基础设施的一线防御者。AI 正被直接部署到网络攻防一线。
stories.analysis: 把 10 亿美元砸向防御侧，既是能力输出，也是安全标准与生态的争夺。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI introduces Daybreak for Frontline Defenders. A $1 billion commitment expands access to frontier cyber AI, training, and support for essential services.

stories.title: Kimi 母公司月之暗面瞄准 20 亿美元年收入，K3 每日生成 3000 亿 token
stories.sourceTitle: Kimi-maker Moonshot AI targets $2B in annual revenue
stories.summary: 尽管 K3 近几个月使用量略有下滑，OpenRouter 数据显示 K3 系列每天在该平台生成多达 3000 亿 token。中国大模型公司开始用收入目标而非热度说话。
stories.analysis: 从流量叙事切换到商业指标，是这批模型必须跨过的一道坎。
stories.sourceExcerpt: While K3's usage figures have declined slightly in recent months, OpenRouter data currently shows as many as 300 billion tokens being generated each day by K3 models on the system.

stories.title: 澳大利亚律所 Gilbert + Tobin 如何治理并规模化部署 ChatGPT Enterprise 和 Codex
stories.sourceTitle: How law firm Gilbert + Tobin governs and scales AI with OpenAI
stories.summary: 案例显示该律所结合 CEO 主导的投入、严格治理框架和人工问责机制，在全所范围内推广 ChatGPT Enterprise 与 Codex。专业服务业的 AI 落地开始以治理为前提。
stories.analysis: 律所出售的是责任，治理框架比模型版本更决定能否真正规模化。
stories.sourceExcerpt: See how Gilbert + Tobin combines CEO-led commitment, rigorous governance, and human accountability to scale ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex across the firm.

stories.title: Polimill 用 OpenAI GPT 模型和 Codex 打造日本新一代公共 AI 基础设施
stories.sourceTitle: Polimill builds Japan's next-generation public AI infrastructure
stories.summary: Polimill 借助 GPT 模型与 Codex，帮助日本地方政府检索和使用行政知识，同时加快自身开发速度。公共部门 AI 落地有了具体样本。
stories.analysis: 政务场景对准确性和可追溯性要求最高，是检验模型能力的好试金石。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Polimill uses OpenAI GPT models and Codex to help municipalities search and use administrative knowledge while accelerating development.

stories.title: Anthropic 报告指称阿里巴巴、月之暗面和 DeepSeek 持续进行模型蒸馏
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic details distillation campaigns from Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek
stories.summary: Anthropic 周四发布的报告指称中国 AI 公司长期开展蒸馏攻击，且随着竞争加剧在近几个月升级。模型蒸馏正从技术问题上升为合规与商业争端。
stories.analysis: 蒸馏取证困难，这类指控最终大概率落到服务条款和出口管制层面。
stories.sourceExcerpt: A new report released Thursday by Anthropic alleges persistent distillation attacks by China-based AI companies, which have escalated in recent months as competition in the space has intensified.

stories.title: ChatGPT Ads 年化收入运行率达 10 亿美元并启动全球扩张
stories.sourceTitle: A milestone in expanding access to AI
stories.summary: OpenAI 称 ChatGPT Ads 年化收入运行率已达 10 亿美元，并开始向全球扩展，通过免费和低价选项支撑更广泛的 AI 可及性。广告成为 AI 普及的补贴来源。
stories.analysis: 广告变现让免费 AI 可持续，但也把注意力经济引入了对话界面。
stories.sourceExcerpt: ChatGPT Ads reaches $1 billion in annualized revenue run rate and expands globally, supporting broader access to AI through free and affordable options.

stories.title: OpenAI 扩大巴西布局，加深与开发者、企业和社区的合作
stories.sourceTitle: Expanding OpenAI’s presence in Brazil
stories.summary: OpenAI 正在巴西扩展业务，深化与本地开发者、企业和社区的互动，以推动全国范围的 AI 采用。拉美成为其国际化重点市场之一。
stories.analysis: 在监管和算力本地化压力下，区域深耕比全球统一发布更有效。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI is expanding its presence in Brazil, deepening engagement with developers, businesses, and communities to support AI adoption across the country.

stories.title: OpenAI 新报告：学生与教师如何用 ChatGPT 把学习延伸到课堂之外
stories.sourceTitle: Learning never stops: How AI makes learning continuous
stories.summary: OpenAI 的新报告探讨学生和教育者如何使用 ChatGPT 让学习变得更连续，使支持场景从课堂内延伸到课外。教育仍是 ChatGPT 使用最广泛的场景之一。
stories.analysis: 需求真实存在，但学校更在意的依然是学术诚信与数据保护。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI’s new report explores how students and educators use ChatGPT to make learning more continuous, with support that extends beyond the classroom.

stories.title: OpenAI 公布 Hugging Face 安全事件调查结果及后续加固措施
stories.sourceTitle: The Hugging Face incident and the road ahead
stories.summary: OpenAI 分享了 Hugging Face 安全事件的调查发现，以及为强化模型安全、监控和对齐所采取的行动。开源模型分发平台的安全风险被正式摆上台面。
stories.analysis: 模型供应链安全正在获得与模型能力同等的关注度。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI shares findings from the Hugging Face security incident and the steps we’re taking to strengthen AI model security, monitoring, and alignment.

stories.title: 太初元碁 Hypertintellix 超智融合计算系统入选“算力中国·年度卓越成就”
stories.sourceTitle: “算力中国·年度卓越成就”发布 太初元碁超智融合计算系统入选
stories.summary: 太初（杭州）集成电路有限公司的新一代超智融合计算系统元碁 Hypertintellix 入选“算力中国·年度卓越成就”。国产算力在超算与智算融合方向获得行业认可。
stories.analysis: 国产算力的比拼正从单卡指标转向系统级融合效率。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 太初（杭州）集成电路有限公司新一代超智融合计算系统元碁Hypertintellix入选“算力中国·年度卓越成就”。
